findings.quote: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
findings.rationale: Section 7 excludes indirect damages but contains no aggregate liability cap at all, so our direct liability (including under the broad Customer indemnity in 10(b)) is unlimited. Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap.

replacement.oldText: EVEN IF THE OTHER PARTY WAS OR SHOULD HAVE BEEN AWARE OR WAS ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
replacement.newText: EVEN IF THE OTHER PARTY WAS OR SHOULD HAVE BEEN AWARE OR WAS ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES. EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE TO KUBIENT UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We added a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 because the section currently leaves both parties' direct liability unlimited. Indemnification, confidentiality/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap.

findings.quote: Kubient agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer and its officers, directors, managers, members, agents, and employees from all third-party allegations, claims, actions, losses, expenses, damages, costs (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees) or liabilities ("Claims") arising out of or in connection with:
findings.rationale: Kubient's indemnity covers the Services, the Auction Platform and breach of its warranties (which include the non-infringement warranty in 9(b)(i)), with standard notice/control/cooperation procedures. No change required, though we should keep this outside any liability cap.

findings.quote: This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
findings.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds us; the Agreement expressly preserves our freedom to use other agents and sell inventory elsewhere.

findings.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient.
findings.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on us; the non-exclusivity is stated expressly.
No most-favoured-nation or price-matching obligation burdening us appears in the Agreement.
No non-solicitation or no-hire restriction binds us.

findings.quote: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
findings.rationale: We have no convenience right during the Initial Term and thereafter must give 90 days' notice, while Kubient may walk away mid-term on the same 90 days' notice. Our position is Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund, and no Vendor convenience right during a committed term.

replacement.oldText: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
replacement.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Exhibit for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days written notice to Kubient, in which case Kubient shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Kubient may terminate this Agreement for any reason effective only at the end of the then-current Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to Customer.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We added a Customer right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice and limited Kubient's convenience right to the end of a term; we can accept 60 days' notice for us as a fallback.

findings.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
findings.rationale: Renewal is automatic with no express non-renewal window, so exit effectively requires the 90 days' notice under the following sentence. Our position is a non-renewal window of no more than 30 days (60 days as fallback) with 12-month renewal terms.

replacement.oldText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
replacement.newText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless either Party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term, or unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We added a 30-day non-renewal window (60 days is our fallback) so renewal is not effectively locked in by the 90-day termination notice.

findings.quote: Any controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach thereof, shall be settled by arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules
findings.rationale: Delaware law with exclusive New York courts is acceptable, but Section 8 mandates AAA arbitration with no stated seat, which contradicts the exclusive court venue in 14(a); Section 8 also cuts the limitation period to one year. We prefer courts and a single, consistent forum.

replacement.oldText: Any controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach thereof, shall be settled by arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules, and judgment on the award rendered by the arbitrator(s) may be entered in any court having jurisdiction thereof
replacement.newText: Any controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach thereof, shall be brought exclusively in the state and federal courts located in New York, New York, consistent with Section 14(a)
replacement.comment: [Playbook] The arbitration clause conflicts with the exclusive New York court venue in 14(a); we prefer courts. If arbitration is retained, the seat must be New York, New York and the one-year limitation period should be deleted.

findings.quote: either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction
findings.rationale: Mutual consent standard (not unreasonably withheld) with an affiliate/M&A carve-out for us, and no Vendor termination or re-pricing right on our change of control. Meets our fallback.

findings.quote: "Request(s)" means the data sent from Customer to Kubient that is used in the auction to determine a Bid.
findings.rationale: Nothing assigns our IP or data to Kubient, but the Agreement is silent on ownership of Customer Data (Requests, Content, visitor/audience data) and gives Kubient no express use limits. We want an explicit statement that we retain all rights in Customer Data.

replacement.oldText: (b) Each Party's names, trademarks and logos are the exclusive property of said respective Party, and neither Party will acquire any proprietary rights therein by reason of this Agreement or any other agreement.
replacement.newText: (b) Each Party's names, trademarks and logos are the exclusive property of said respective Party, and neither Party will acquire any proprietary rights therein by reason of this Agreement or any other agreement. As between the Parties, Customer retains all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Properties, the Requests and all other data provided by or collected on Customer's behalf ("Customer Data"), and Kubient acquires no rights therein other than the limited right to use Customer Data as necessary to provide the Services.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We added a Customer Data ownership sentence because the Agreement is otherwise silent on who owns the data we put into the Auction Platform; Kubient keeps ownership of its platform.

findings.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
findings.rationale: The licence is revocable at will and excludes our affiliates and contractors, which is on our walk-away list. Our position is a licence covering affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, terminable only in accordance with the termination provisions and transferable to a successor.

replacement.oldText: a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
replacement.newText: a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive license, extending to Customer's affiliates and to contractors acting on Customer's behalf and transferable to a successor in accordance with Section 14(h), to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, terminable only in accordance with Section 4
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We deleted "revocable" and extended the licence to our affiliates and contractors; a licence revocable at the Vendor's discretion is not acceptable. Affiliates on written notice is our fallback.

findings.rationale: No audit, inspection or verification right against us appears in the Agreement.

findings.quote: Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
findings.rationale: No liquidated damages or penalty is payable by us; this provision only preserves Kubient's share of revenue actually generated during the notice period.

findings.quote: (ii) the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
findings.rationale: The express warranties are reasonable in scope and survive the disclaimer, but no warranty remedy (re-performance, repair/replacement or refund) is specified. We want an express remedy so the warranty has teeth.

replacement.oldText: (ii) the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
replacement.newText: (ii) the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards and in conformity with its documentation, and for any breach of this warranty Kubient shall promptly re-perform, repair or replace the non-conforming Service or, if it fails to do so within thirty (30) days, refund the fees attributable to the non-conforming Service;
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We added the standard warranty remedy (re-performance, repair/replacement or refund); the warranty currently has no stated remedy.

findings.rationale: There is no insurance clause, although Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and handles visitor data. We require CGL, E&O and cyber cover with certificates on request.

replacement.newText:
14. General Provisions.

(j) Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Kubient processes Customer Data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance on request.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We inserted our standard insurance requirement for vendors that host services and process our data; E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M is our fallback.

findings.quote: (iv) and each Party will return or destroy any of the other Party's Confidential Information then in its possession.
findings.rationale: Section 4(c) provides only for cessation of the Services and return/destruction of Confidential Information, with no transition assistance and no return of our data in a usable format. We require transition help and a data-return/deletion-certification obligation.

replacement.oldText: (iv) and each Party will return or destroy any of the other Party's Confidential Information then in its possession.
replacement.newText: (iv) each Party will return or destroy any of the other Party's Confidential Information then in its possession; and (v) Kubient shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Kubient's then-current rates, within thirty (30) days return all Customer Data (including Requests and reporting data) in a commonly used, machine-readable format, and thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We added transition assistance and data return/deletion on exit; 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days is our fallback.
